tasks.title: --commit with an unchanged value isn't a failure
tasks.summary: ws update <id> --verify <same value> --commit says refused: commit failed, though nothing is wrong, and on a later day it would commit only a date.
acceptance: A test: the same --verify, and the same --notes, with --commit print <id>: nothing changed, exit 0 and leave HEAD where it was
A test: the same value on a queue dated earlier also commits nothing and leaves the file as it was
A test: the same text and decision with --summary --because --commit says the same
A test: a real change with --commit still commits

tasks.title: A fresh worker can pick up a dead worker's worktree
tasks.summary: ws-run offers landing or requeueing for a leftover, and requeueing discards a dead worker's uncommitted work. LO-08's replacement worked only because of two extra lines in its prompt (left_open D016).
acceptance: A test: an in-progress task with uncommitted files in its worktree gets a Picking up section that lists them, capped with a count of the rest
A test: commits since baseCommit are counted there
A test: a freshly claimed task's brief has no Picking up section
A test: with evidence already in the worktree, the finish step updates that file rather than starting a new one
The ws-run leftovers step names a fresh worker on the same worktree with no new claim, and step 4 points to it instead of treating the worker as blocked; tests.test_rule_map passes
make audit passes

tasks.title: is_open reads only an entry's ending
tasks.summary: is_open matches the open mark anywhere, so a closed reason quoting it renders with no ending and counts as open. It is the problem LO-04 fixed for the other mark.
acceptance: A test: a body quoting the open mark mid-text renders with the closed ending and isn't in open_entries
A test: a body ending in the open mark stays open, with or without trailing whitespace
A test: a proposal quoting the open mark mid-text with no Rejected line is reported by evidence.problems
The protocol's worker section says to end a proposal with the mark
make audit passes

tasks.title: ws update reports a mode that --requires raised
tasks.summary: --requires can raise mode to foreground, and the ws update line says only requires.
acceptance: A test: --requires with a forcing value on a background task prints updated <id>: requires, which raised mode to foreground
A test: a task already foreground, a value that forces nothing, and an explicit --mode print no such words

tasks.title: The brief says a long verify isn't a hang
tasks.summary: ws verify takes minutes, the shell can move it to the background, and elapsed time can include the machine sleeping. A worker judging a hang by elapsed time could kill a healthy run.
acceptance: A test: step 1 of a brief's finish section says to wait for a backgrounded verify to exit and not to kill it, because it enforces its own time limit
tests.test_no_project_literals passes
make audit passes

acceptance: harness.SCENARIOS has leftover, with setup leaving uncommitted partial work in the claimed worktree and no evidence
A test: with the stub, the good behaviour passes the check
A test: with the stub, a worker that discards the partial work or requeues the task fails the check
